content.text: {"id": "mm6524a4", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The percentage of the U.S. population that is protected increased from 2.72% in 2000 to 47.8% in 2010 and 49.6% in 2015."}, {"loc": "summary", "q": "Overall, nearly 50% of the U.S. population is protected by smoke-free laws."}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The percentage of the U.S. population that is protected increased from 2.72% in 2000 to 47.8% in 2010 and 49.6% in 2015."}, {"loc": "table 2", "q": "State population with local comprehensive smoke-free laws (%)"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, 49.6% of the U.S. population was protected by state or local comprehensive smoke-free laws as of December 31, 2015."}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "increased from zero on December 31, 2000 to 26 on December 31, 2010"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Regional disparities remain in the proportions of state populations covered by state or local comprehensive smoke-free policies"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Data on state smoke-free policies were obtained from CDC’s State Tobacco Activities Tracking and Evaluation (STATE) System database."}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "increased from zero in 2000 to 27 in 2015"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "was calculated using 2007 U.S. Census data"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The number of states with comprehensive smoke-free laws during 2000–2015 was assessed."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
